name: Hebei Keli Automobile Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Hebei Keli Automobile Equipment Co., Ltd., established in 2013 and headquartered in Qinhuangdao, China, specializes in the design, production, and distribution of components for automotive glass assemblies. The company offers an extensive range of products, including essential parts for windshield installation such as locator pins, weather stripping, lower profiles, spacers, and mounts for camera and rain sensors. For side windows, their offerings encompass various lift components like injection and aluminum holders, as well as division bars. Furthermore, they supply complete window assembly elements, including decorative metal trim, inserts, and sealing products. Beyond glass-related items, Hebei Keli also manufactures an assortment of other vehicle parts, such as fasteners, hinges, overhead console fastener tracks, and diverse protective brackets. The company not only serves the domestic Chinese market but also exports its products internationally to regions including North America, Europe, and South America.
